summary: This clinical trial tested if a medicine called survodutide helps adults with overweight or obesity who do not have diabetes to lose weight. The study compared two different doses of survodutide against an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. Participants received either the medicine or the inactive substance by injection under the skin once a week. This was a Phase 3 study sponsored by Boehringer Ingelheim with 726 participants, and the status is Completed.
